description: Remove negative keywords (by id, from list_microsoft_ads_negative_keywords) from a Microsoft Advertising campaign or ad group. On a LIVE campaign that lets those searches trigger paid ads again, so it needs confirm:true after the user agrees. Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: ad group to remove negatives from; pass this or campaignId

campaignId.description: campaign to remove negatives from; pass this or adGroupId

confirm.description: REQUIRED true on a LIVE campaign

negativeKeywordIds.description: ids of the negative keywords to remove, from list_microsoft_ads_negative_keywords

name: remove_microsoft_ads_negative_keywords
title: Remove Microsoft Advertising negative keywords
